description: This Java class implements a histogram using the Kamon monitoring library. It provides methods for creating, tagging, resetting, recording values, and retrieving recorded metric values, encapsulating Kamon histogram functionalities.

classes.name: KamonHistogram
classes.description: Implementing a Histogram interface using Kamon metrics, allowing creation, tagging, resetting, and retrieving recorded data, with thread-safe immutable design.

methods.name: newHistogram
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Histogram with a given name and no tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with an added key-value tag.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with multiple tags added or replaced.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given tag key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of all tags.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the histogram's snapshot; returns false if unsuccessful.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a value into the histogram.

methods.name: getRecordedValues
methods.description: Returns all recorded values as an array of Long.

methods.name: addBucketValuesToList
methods.description: Adds values from a histogram bucket to a list, repeated by bucket frequency.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the histogram's current distribution, optionally resetting.

methods.name: getKamonInternalHistogram
methods.description: Fetches the Kamon histogram instance with the current name and tags.
